architecture.A1_context: Windows驗收整合；免安裝artifact與跨模組證據
architecture.A2_hexagonal: UI/Test → Input Tauri commands → DispatchHost → HOST usecase → WORK/domain → output abstractions ← adapters
architecture.A3_dependency: M08 orchestrates its own domain; shared roles coordinated via explicit ports, no UI→adapter bypass
architecture.A6_output_ports: 隔離FS/程序/artifact讀取；不用自動派工服務。
architecture.A7_driving_adapters: Vanilla UI / module tests / Windows native operator
architecture.A8_driven_adapters: Std/FakeFileSystem; any OS/codec/clock capability must be approved, not invented manager
architecture.A9_direction: Domain must not depend on UI/FS/OS/Tauri/concrete adapters
architecture.A10_ownership: 只讀版本與驗收證據，不擁有其他模組domain authority。
architecture.A11_mutation: All authoritative mutations through approved input/usecase; projections/codec cannot mutate another document
architecture.A12_transaction: lock artifact → isolated extract/launch/move → native流程 → verify來源不變 → report；不發布。
architecture.A13_external: Untrusted package/media/path inputs; no AI/Git/plugin/startup execution authority
architecture.A14_forbidden: UI→FS/Git/MCP/adapters; Domain→framework; recovery/asset silently changing active content; cross-file merge escape

contract.preconditions: Bound project and correct document/session identity, supported input and approved current revision; proposal details await decisions
contract.success: Result reflects committed version, no error contradiction; design/build status never equals functional acceptance
contract.failure: Refuse/cancel preserves originals; single-document merge rolls back complete before-state; rollback-failure safeguards require D5
contract.ownership: 只讀版本與驗收證據，不擁有其他模組domain authority。
contract.atomicity: lock artifact → isolated extract/launch/move → native流程 → verify來源不變 → report；不發布。
contract.lifecycle: Per-open document history; no cross-document or restart Undo; session IDs isolate recovery, not permission to overwrite formal files
invariants: 任一拒絕／取消／失敗不得破壞原有效資料；合併要求回到完整合併前狀態。
文件權威狀態由所屬文件模型持有；UI、序列化、預覽、差異方案及快照均非第二個可任意寫回的SSOT。
成功結果與錯誤結果互斥；NOT RUN、生成完成、預覽可操作與正式功能驗證分開。
匯入及預覽不執行包內程式，不洩露憑證，不寫出指定目錄。

"""TDD — Scene pack .ess (XML) = work + architecture + design in one document."""

from __future__ import annotations

import re
import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
UI = ROOT / "apps" / "sgenaxis-desktop" / "ui"
HTML = UI / "index.html"
JS = UI / "app.js"
FIXDIR = ROOT / "fixtures" / "sgenaxis-scene"
ESS = FIXDIR / "sample.ess"


def test_scene_ess_ui_and_codec_hooks():
    html = HTML.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    assert 'data-cmd="scene.saveXml"' in html
    assert 'data-cmd="scene.openXml"' in html
    assert ".ess" in html
    assert 'id="toolbar-scene-open"' in html
    assert 'id="toolbar-scene-save"' in html
    js = JS.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    assert "sceneDocToSgsXml" in js
    assert "sceneDocFromSgsXml" in js
    assert "applySceneSgsXml" in js
    assert "saveSceneSgsToProject" in js
    assert "loadSceneSgsFromProject" in js
    assert "SCENE_SGS_REL" in js
    assert "scene/default.ess" in js
    assert 'format="eluslot.ess"' in js or "eluslot.ess" in js
    assert 'cmd === "scene.saveXml"' in js
    assert 'cmd === "scene.openXml"' in js


def test_sample_ess_fixture_is_xml_scene():
    assert ESS.is_file()
    raw = ESS.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    assert "<eluslotScene" in raw
    assert 'format="eluslot.ess"' in raw
    assert 'encoding="xml"' in raw
    assert "<work" in raw
    assert "<architecture" in raw
    assert "<eluslotArch" in raw
    assert "<design" in raw
    root = ET.fromstring(raw)
    assert re.sub(r"\{.*\}", "", root.tag) == "eluslotScene"
    assert root.attrib.get("format") == "eluslot.ess"
    work = root.find("work")
    arch = root.find("architecture")
    design = root.find("design")
    assert work is not None
    assert arch is not None
    assert design is not None

decisions.title: 首版模板、Viewer及媒體矩陣
decisions.observation: 有Vanilla/Tauri與卡片communication preview；尚未見版本化雙骨架模板與完整media codec。
decisions.recommendation: 首個生成模板採本機Vanilla UI＋Tauri2；空白可定義草稿；Viewer先做批准的導覽/表單/對話框假資料。PNG/JPEG/受限靜態SVG優先；動圖/影片逐格式實測切片，不刪需求也不假稱支援。
decisions.alternatives: 一次全部框架/宿主/媒體需要擴大驗證；只存定義不生成會縮已確認需求，不能自行採用。
decisions.blocking: 只阻擋對應生成/preview/media；非全域停工。

decisions.observation: 主新建拒existing；舊入口remove同路徑file；portable README只是歷史。
decisions.recommendation: 依已確認規則統一拒已有目標；若舊test要求刪file，列契約遷移並批准測試revision，不能偷偷改expected。Windows11 x64/WebView2實測＋新artifact lock再驗收。
decisions.alternatives: 只保護主UI保留舊刪檔入口會不一致；舊binary驗新需求不可採。
decisions.blocking: 不重問是否保護資料，只需精確修改scope/測試遷移及環境驗收計畫。
